backward_compat_traps.rule: PTPv2 (1588-2008) is not wire-compatible with PTPv1 (1588-2002).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Assuming a v1 node can sync to a v2 node is wrong; versionPTP differs.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Two-step clocks send T1 in a Follow_Up; one-step embed it in Sync.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Ignoring the Follow_Up on a two-step master loses the precise T1.

backward_compat_traps.rule: The end-to-end (Delay_Req/Resp) and peer-to-peer (Pdelay) delay mechanisms are mutually exclusive on a path.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Mixing E2E and P2P on the same link is invalid; 802.1AS uses P2P only.

backward_compat_traps.rule: PTP rides over Ethernet/UDP but is a clock-sync protocol (Sync/Delay/BMCA/Grandmaster), not an Ethernet MAC/PHY.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Treating PTP as just an Ethernet frame ignores the timing structure (T1..T4, offset, correctionField).

fields.ic_name: IEEE 1588 Precision Time Protocol (PTP) Clock Synchronization Engine (PTPv2 / IEEE 802.1AS)
previous_versions: IEEE 1588-2008 (PTPv2) — redesigned message set, Transparent Clocks, peer delay, correctionField, profiles.
IEEE 802.1AS-2011 (gPTP) — first TSN/AVB profile of PTP.

key_changes.summary: Replaced PTPv1's message set; added Transparent Clocks and the correctionField, the peer delay mechanism, one-step/two-step Sync, profiles, and Ethernet (0x88F7) transport. NOT wire-compatible with PTPv1.
A constrained PTP profile for TSN/AVB: peer delay on every link, two-step Sync+Follow_Up, an alternate BMCA, and Layer-2 0x88F7 only; every bridge is a time-aware system.
High-accuracy enhancements, modular optional features, and security TLVs; backward compatible framework with PTPv2.

future_versions_industry_outline.summary: Continued refinement of gPTP for time-aware networks; multiple time domains and improved fault tolerance.

fields.version_naming_history_note: The Precision Time Protocol is standardized by the IEEE 1588 Working Group. PTPv1 (IEEE 1588-2002) was superseded by PTPv2 (IEEE 1588-2008), which redesigned the message set and added Transparent Clocks, the correctionField, the peer delay mechanism, and profiles. IEEE 802.1AS (gPTP) is a constrained PTP profile for TSN/AVB, and IEEE 1588-2019 added high-accuracy and security enhancements while preserving the PTPv2 framework.
